title: One GitHub Issue Into a PR
script: Can AI take one mobile bug from issue to a reviewable change? The job is narrow: fix the menu below six hundred and forty pixels, without breaking desktop. I asked it to reproduce the bug before changing the code. Then I checked keyboard navigation, the boundary widths, and the desktop menu. [VALIDATION_RESULT]. The change touched [FILES_CHANGED] files, with [REMAINING_ISSUE]. Would you trust this change after reviewing the evidence?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Fix mobile navigation below 640px, reproduce, test and prepare a reviewable change.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: Can AI take one mobile bug from issue to a reviewable change?
The menu breaks at 639 pixels. Can AI fix just that?
A reviewable diff needs more than a finished message.
strongestHook: Can AI take one mobile bug from issue to a reviewable change?
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Fix mobile navigation below 640px, reproduce, test and prepare a reviewable change. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Use a local practice repository and a mobile-navigation issue with reproduction at 639px. Ask the agent to reproduce, fix only the issue, test and prepare a reviewable diff and PR description. Check 390px, 639px, 640px and desktop; keyboard open/close, Escape and links. Record files changed and relevant passing/failing tests. A local PR draft suffices; posting or merging is outside this recording protocol.
evidenceRequirements: Use a test repo; validate behavior, regressions and actual outcome.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “One Bug One Change” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: Would you trust this change after reviewing the evidence?
instagramCaption: One GitHub Issue Into a PR. Fix mobile navigation below 640px, reproduce, test and prepare a reviewable change. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. Would you trust this change after reviewing the evidence?
tiktokCaption: One GitHub Issue Into a PR. WOULD YOU APPROVE IT?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
